_: Every job of Juegos de Salón, wherever it runs (D-365). A job that is not here does not exist: jobs.test.mjs fails if a scheduled workflow is missing, and `jobs.mjs install` only installs what is here. `node tools/jobs/jobs.mjs status` shows them all with their last run.

jobs.what: Checks the hola@ inbox without Claude; only when an email is waiting it runs the support agent headless (Haiku) and uploads the reports as issues at once.

Uploads the new 🐞 and email feedback reports from Firebase as `feedback` issues (reads with the owner's admin key; `gh` makes the issues). Each pass also deletes the reply emails left more than 90 days ago without a reply (D-463). `feedback.yml` stays as a manual fallback.
Sends La Copa's Web Push notifications that are due.

Rebuilds Uno al día's month of points from the history, with the days a phone's 🧊 saved, and corrects any total that differs; also writes the season's places by week (uadTemporada/). Then deletes the names in stats/ older than 24 months (stats-retention.mjs).
Saves the podium of every finished Cup nobody reopened, so its champions reach the medal table.
Opens the "Processes round missed" issue when a commit on main has gone more than a day without the processes round looking at it, and closes it when the round catches up.
Keeps the "Pending work" issue current with the open PRs that are stuck and the branches whose commits never reached main and have no PR; closes it when nothing is left.

The processes agent's daily round at 4:30 (the Mac mini keeps Pacific time): a headless Claude session that follows its prompt, launching documentation, usability, support and ideas, handling feedback and collecting the changelog. round-watch checks it ran.
Sunday 8:00: a headless Claude session that runs `node tools/reports/weekly.mjs --send`, the week's PDF emailed to the owner.
Deletes merged, empty and abandoned worktrees at the start of every Claude session in this repo.
